primary_metric: max sampled contour error with every singular neighbourhood removed; the reference is certified only there

tasks.prompt: Steady two-dimensional heat conduction (Laplace equation) in a rectilinear plate with vertices, in order, (0,0), (1,0), (1,0.6), (0,0.6). The bottom edge y = 0 is held at 100 C; every other edge is held at 0 C. Draw the plate outline and the isotherms at 10, 20, 40, 60 and 80 C. Use viewBox="0 0 1000 1000". Map plate coordinates to drawing coordinates as X = 100 + 800 x and Y = 900 - 800 y. Wrap every contour in one <g data-field="T" data-status="..."> group and set data-status honestly to one of solved, estimated, illustrative or ill-posed. Draw every contour as its own <path> or <polyline> carrying a data-level attribute with its numeric level and label it. Contours must satisfy the boundary conditions exactly.
